programs.title: Trolls World Tour
programs.desc: Poppy lives a peaceful life in her colorful and singing kingdom.One day he learns that beyond his borders there are other lands inhabited by trolls.Each of them has different rhythms.Just as she loves pop, the creatures inhabiting distant lands prefer rock, funk, techno, country and classical music.The curious queen, together with Mruk and other friends, sets off on a journey to meet and unite her kin.She will have to face the rebellious Barb, who wants to ensure that only rock rules in all lands.The continuation of the 2016 hit sticks to a proven recipe for success - a joyful, extremely colorful animation packed with great hits, showing the unifying power of music and the need for tolerance.The pandemic made the film go down in cinema history as the first high-budget production that went straight to VOD services, without a cinema premiere.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Magdalena Wasylik (Poppy), Piotr Bajtlik (Mruk) and Monika Węgiel-Jarocińska (Barb).

programs.title: Minecraft
programs.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programs.title: Queen Of The Ring
programs.desc: 1930s.Single mother Mildred Bliss (Emily Bett Rickards), who has always been interested in sports, dreams of becoming a wrestler.When she meets the promoter of this sport, Billy Wolfe (Josh Lucas), she decides to try her hand at this discipline, although it belongs entirely to men and the law prohibits women from entering the ring.It quickly turns out that he can cope very well, even with players who are more powerful than himself.Billy becomes her manager and lover, and soon her husband.The increasingly successful woman adopts the pseudonym Mildred Burke and over time becomes the first millionaire wrestling professional.Unfortunately, her successes in the ring do not go hand in hand with a successful personal life.First of all, her marriage is not a happy one.Based on a true story about the life of women's wrestling pioneer Mildred Burke.

programs.title: The dragon's bloodline
programs.desc: The history of House Targaryen.Its leader, Viserys I (Paddy Considine), ruler of the Seven Kingdoms, decides to break with tradition.The king appoints his daughter, Princess Rhaenyra (Milly Alcock and Emma D'Arcy), as heir to the Iron Throne.This step leads to the initiation of a conflict within the family, called the Dance of Dragons.After the ruler's death, the fratricidal fight breaks out with renewed force.Also taking part in it are:Rhaenyra's brother, Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney), and Alicent Hightower (Emily Carey and Olivia Cooke), the second wife of Viserys I. The events told in the series precede the action of "Game of Thrones" by 200 years.
